items.title: UTL 牌照取消：先确认监管状态，再评估资产与债权
items.titleEn: UTL cancellation: verify regulatory status before asset or credit decisions
items.status: 官方取消通知已发布；资产处置结果未确认
items.statusEn: Official cancellation notice published; disposal outcome unconfirmed
items.summary: NTA发布题为UTL牌照自动取消的紧急通知。本期公告与9月4日续期截止是不同时间点；基础设施移交的媒体报道不等于每项资产的最终权属结论。
items.summaryEn: NTA published an urgent notice of UTL's automatic licence cancellation. The notice and the earlier renewal deadline are distinct milestones. Media accounts of handover do not settle title to every asset.
items.businessImpact: 业务影响（研判）：相关供货和债权交易需重新核查交易对手权限、付款保障及担保物；不推断政府承担全部债务。
items.businessImpactEn: Business implication (analysis): reassess counterparty authority, payment security and collateral. Do not infer government assumption of all liabilities.
actions: 取得官方通知及后续处置文件，交当地律师核查适用条款与救济状态。
在权属与债权顺位确认前，不以旧牌照或新闻报道作为新增授信依据。
actionsEn: Obtain the notice and subsequent orders; ask local counsel to verify applicable provisions and any challenge.
Do not extend credit on the strength of the former licence or press reports before confirming title and creditor priority.

items.title: 800MHz 竞价说明会：程序公告不是频谱许可
items.titleEn: 800 MHz pre-bid notice is not a spectrum authorization
items.status: 投标前程序公告；未确认授标
items.statusEn: Pre-bid procedural notice; no award confirmed
items.summary: 公告将说明会安排在9月18日尼泊尔时间16:30。它更新的是竞价准备程序，不证明任何申请人已取得频谱，也不披露设备采购合同。
items.summaryEn: The notice schedules the conference for 18 September at 16:30 Nepal time. It concerns bid preparation, not an applicant's spectrum entitlement or an equipment contract.
items.businessImpact: 业务影响（研判）：网络方案可提前准备，但合同生效、交付和融资安排应关联实际获许可及客户预算。
items.businessImpactEn: Business implication (analysis): prepare network options, but condition delivery and financing on actual authorization and customer budget.
actions: 取得正式RFA及答疑／修订版本，核对资格、保证金、频段和时限。
会后核验纪要与后续决定；不得用竞价邀请替代频谱授予文件。
actionsEn: Obtain the RFA and amendments; check eligibility, security, band details and deadlines.
Verify minutes and later decisions; never substitute an invitation for a spectrum award.

disclaimer: 用于商务风险识别，不构成法律意见。草案、正式公布、生效与执行须分别核验。
disclaimerEn: For business-risk awareness, not legal advice. Drafting, publication, commencement and enforcement must be verified separately.
